_note: Query 6: aws ce get-cost-and-usage --time-period Start=2026-03-05,End=2026-05-06 --granularity DAILY --metrics AmortizedCost UnblendedCost --filter '{"Dimensions":{"Key":"RECORD_TYPE","Values":["Usage","DiscountedUsage","SavingsPlanCoveredUsage"]}}' --group-by Type=DIMENSION,Key=SERVICE. 62 days, ending 2 days before 'now' (2026-05-08); End is exclusive. 'Usage' = the three usage record types; the primary metric is AmortizedCost, which prices Savings-Plan-covered usage at its effective commitment rate. Only the EC2 line differs between the two metrics (covered m5/r5 usage: amortized = effective rate, unblended = on-demand value); the other four services have no commitment, so both metrics are identical. Not usage and therefore not in this file: SavingsPlanRecurringFee (unused commitment under amortization), SavingsPlanUpfrontFee, SavingsPlanNegation, Support - see record-type-breakdown.json. The last two days (2026-05-04, 2026-05-05) are returned with Estimated=true and are still filling in (values are partial): the skill drops them, which leaves 60 complete days = two equal 30-day windows, previous 2026-03-05..2026-04-03 and current 2026-04-04..2026-05-03.
